zap.name: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy Header Missing or Invalid
zap.reason: Set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin centrally. This API has no intended cross-origin no-cors embedding; revisit if a cross-origin browser consumer is introduced.

zap.name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
zap.reason: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff in outer router middleware, preserving JSON/Prometheus Content-Type values.

zap.name: Non-Storable Content
zap.reason: Informational cache-policy observation, not a false scanner claim. Non-storable API/error responses are intentional; no-store protects notes and avoids stale state. Revisit cache requirements on 2027-01-26 or before adding a UI/cache.

zap.name: Storable and Cacheable Content
zap.reason: The reported responses could be heuristically cached. Add Cache-Control: no-store to all router responses to protect potentially personal notes and fresh state.
